Senses.Note: The dead-tree hall is the institutional hall associated with Shishuang’s dead-tree assembly. Later speakers use its front as a public locale and ask directly what happens there.

EvidenceBody: A named monastic hall carries the pressure of the dead-tree assembly: its stillness becomes something questioned and addressed rather than a generic quiet building.
The phrase names an institutional hall and its inherited case-locale, not every hall containing old timber.
Historical establishment, locale description, and direct question concern the same institutional referent.
